user.title: FERMAX Connection Credentials
user.description: Enter your FERMAX DuoxMe account credentials and the OAuth details from the mobile app. For more details on how to obtain these, please see the [documentation]({docs_link}).

fcm.title: Push Notification Credentials (FCM)
fcm.description: Enter the Google Firebase Cloud Messaging (FCM) credentials. These are required to receive real-time notifications from your doorbell, and a core part of this integration. For a detailed guide, see the [documentation]({docs_link}).

reconfigure.title: Reconfigure FERMAX credentials
reconfigure.description: Enter the FERMAX username and password to use. OAuth and FCM settings and integration options will be kept. The credentials are validated before the integration is reloaded.

reauth_confirm.title: Re-authenticate FERMAX
reauth_confirm.description: FERMAX rejected the saved credentials for {username}. Enter the current password.

error.invalid_auth: Invalid username, password, or client credentials. Please check and try again.
error.cannot_connect: Could not connect to FERMAX to validate the credentials. Please try again.
error.cannot_update: Could not stop the current session or clear its token. Credentials were not changed. Check the logs and try again.
error.unknown: An unknown error occurred. Please check the logs for more details.

abort.already_configured: This Fermax account is already configured.
abort.reconfigure_successful: Credentials updated. The integration will reload.

init.title: FERMAX DuoxMe Options
init.description: Recommended: keep live WebRTC capture disabled and use the latest photo stored by FERMAX. This does not join the call or install optional media packages; the photo may belong to a previous call. Enable doorbell notifications to receive call events; disabling them leaves only the locks. If you enable optional live capture, choose go2rtc or aiortc; failed capture falls back to the FERMAX photo. Unlock duration controls only Home Assistant's unlocked-state indication (1 to 30 seconds, default 2), not the physical door-release pulse.

options.aiortc: aiortc (Python library, installed on first use)
